title: "Add an authorized SSH key to a user"
description: "Adds the key line to the end of ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the user, and makes the directory and the file if they are missing, with modes 700 and 600, owned by the user. A key that the file has already, by its fingerprint, does not change it. A line with no public key is refused. A user that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/user/{name}/sshkey"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds the key line to the end of ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the user, and makes the directory and the file if they are missing, with modes 700 and 600, owned by the user. A key that the file has already, by its fingerprint, does not change it. A line with no public key is refused. A user that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped.
